source_inspection.visual_finding: The entire printed page and the fourfold-resolution crop of all four A2 ciphertext rows were inspected. The twenty-sixth five-coordinate group clearly reads VDFAD. Its final AD, at zero-based source indices 128 and 129, is unambiguous and agrees with the catalog. The crop preserves the RICHI-142 label and neighboring groups.
source_inspection.source_status: DA is a proposed emendation of the printed AD, not a new glyph reading or an OCR correction.

prior_art_review.scope: The full HTML body of Norbert comment 53 and the complete comments 49 through 56 in the cached 2017 thread were read. This is a bounded attribution check, not a global novelty search.
prior_art_review.author: Norbert
prior_art_review.description: Norbert first gives the uncorrected word string, then supplies the correct words in his readable German sentence. He also identifies the earlier p186 transmission. His stated key-label changes are separate substitution-label refinements. The checked discussion does not specify a VDFAD-to-VDFDA group repair, the adjacent source swap, or its source indices.
prior_art_review.cache_context_note: The session already retained the full public HTML. A live web-tool re-open during this check returned HTTP502; the reviewed cached HTML includes author, date, full comment body and neighboring comments.
prior_art_review.credit_conclusion: Norbert retains plaintext-normalization priority. The present audit maps the exact coordinate mechanism and source cost; no global novelty or first-decipherment claim is made.

independent_arithmetic.method: Explicit column lengths and per-column start offsets, independent of the root audit source_map implementation. Every candidate also passes a coordinate-cell roundtrip without completing any unknown square cell.
independent_arithmetic.uniqueness_scope: The entire stated partial reading under the fixed published ranks and partial square, among the 141 tested adjacent source boundaries.
independent_arithmetic.all_completions_argument: Only the two coordinate pairs AG and DG change; they exchange places. Both are attested cells, T and C. Every other pair remains exactly identical. Therefore every injective completion of the fourteen unknown square cells leaves this two-letter repair unchanged; no guessed assignment is needed.

limitations: The mechanism is a source-efficient explanation of words already proposed in 2017, not new plaintext priority.
The source visibly reads AD. The evidence does not establish whether a historical error occurred in enciphering, transmission, interception or later copying.
The seven unresolved ending positions stay unresolved and the known-position count remains 64/71.
The uniqueness claim is restricted to single adjacent swaps under the named fixed key and complete stated partial-reading comparison.
